description: The Load Screening Tool and Effluent Statistics Tool form an Excel package developed for Alberta Environment by Golder Associates Ltd. The catalogue description states that the tools screen effluent compliance with surface-water quality objectives and compute water-quality-based effluent limits from discharge and receiving-water characteristics. This explicit calculation role supports water-quality modelling for wastewater discharges. The source lists a manual and a software ZIP dated April 2004, with Excel 2002 as the development environment and Excel 2000 compatibility. Earlier Excel versions are not necessarily supported. No formulas, input field schema, uncertainty method or contemporary compatibility test was available in the inspected metadata. The accessible CUDC package preserves exact Alberta source identifiers and distribution links; both native Alberta metadata and landing routes returned 403. The catalogue states Alberta’s Open Government Licence, but its applicability to the software payload is unverified, so software reuse terms and source-code availability remain unknown. Costs and payload access are also unknown. No related active tool was identified. The archive and manual were not obtained or executed.
